testNotes: Original Factorio save files were not used. The test ran in an isolated lab surface with only the base mod.
Each run stocked only designated raw-material chests and fluid inlet pipes, provided electricity to the blueprint power network, and took finished logistic robots from the output request chest.
No train delivery or station-to-core bridging was part of the production throughput runs.
The base recipe availability and stated logistics robot technologies were enabled. No productivity modules or crafting productivity boosts were used.

transport.scope: Native 1+1 train arrival and unloading each input or loading the output, with measured stock in the real receiving chest/wagon or independent pipe and tank.

integration.scope: Real connected station logistics boxes and independent fluid buffers to the real output station request chest. Supply and collection were scripted only at those external ports.

trainToTrain.scope: Actual 1+1 trains delivered solids and oils. Electricity, water, 300 robots, and a rail approach segment were supplied by the isolated fixture. Items were counted after a real station inserter loaded the outgoing wagon. Arrivals were staged; this does not validate a city-wide schedule.
